blocks.plain: The Blocked table has no numbered rows, the same as before. Nothing was added. One loose thread survives from 9/12. It is the standing force order for cross-session republishes. BOLO 51's confirmation raised it, and it is still unruled.

strand.last: The Blocked table has been empty since 9/23. That day you ruled #12 (BOLO 35), ratified #14 (BOLO 41) and confirmed #19 (BOLO 51). Nothing new has reached it since.
strand.plan: Table order was unblock order. With the table empty, the next decision that lands here starts a fresh one.
strand.you: No numbered rulings were asked of you. Your 10/5 rulings came in chat. They were the ten interface calls, STOWAGE, the model call and the renumber. None were Blocked rows.
strand.next: Nothing formally blocked. Open in practice: BOLO 51's standing force-order question, unruled since 9/12 night, and 16 unruled interface rows.

blocks.name: The leverage line
blocks.plain: Chief fired the launch sequence at 05:22 on 10/5. All nine stations came up GO. BOLO 102 closed end to end last session. Today still has one fixed clock at 10:00.

strand.last: Claude finished BOLO 102: 220 core-doc pages, the renumber, LEECHSEED, the visuals and the interface layer.
strand.plan: BOLO 100 says every system is done and the whole fabula is built before any pilot writing.
strand.you: You ruled systems first. You have the 10:00 visit today. Sixteen interface rows still wait on you.
strand.next: Keep the 10:00 visit. After it, rule the 16 interface rows and say go on fabula phase 2.

blocks.line: Make the 10:00 visit, then open fabula phase 2 under BOLO 100.
blocks.why: The visit is the only fixed clock on the board. BOLO 102 is done. Fabula phase 2 is the next gate before the pilot.

blocks.name: The SOI card
blocks.plain: The words that run this operation. Say one and the protocol fires. Every term on this page is a live link; hover it, hold, and the definition opens. The full book is the SOI: the BREVITY.

strand.last: Ruled 9/11: DOPE SHEET (the status page) · SOI is the book · "the house tongue" and "glossary" retired · dark is the only theme.
strand.plan: The SOI page replaces the in-page glossary once it publishes (Charlie Mike pages, step 4). BOLO 37 moves rulings into a daily loop.
strand.you: You clarified FRAGO on your own read of doctrine: the update, never the page.
strand.next: Confirm OPORD as the page's word. Name the loop; MINT is the recommendation.
